members.name: For
members.signature: public static PreviewWidget For(Guid asset, int width = 256, int height = 256, bool showGrid = false)

docs.summary: Gets or creates a PreviewWidget for the specified asset, reusing an existing one if its dimensions and grid setting match. Editors are shared between inspector panels - EditorRegistries caches a single instance per asset type - so a widget held as an editor field is reconfigured by every panel every frame, and they all end up drawing whichever asset set it up last. Keying on the asset gives each its own.
Makes an asset's preview set up again on its next draw, if it has one.
Disposes every preview nothing drew since the last call. Called once a frame, before drawing.
Drops the preview for an asset, e.g. once it no longer exists.

docs.summary: Returns the cached PreviewRenderer for the given subject, calling the setup action if the subject has changed or the renderer was just created.
Forces the next call to Get to re-run the setup action for the current subject.
Disposes the underlying PreviewRenderer and resets the widget state.
